deploybot: 🚀 Prod deploy started
deploybot: env=production tag=v3.6.0-rc2 commit=9f8e7d change_window=02:00-02:30UTC expected_duration=~12m initiating canary (traffic 0->10%)

olivia.nguyen: acked, monitoring release notes link https://confluence/redwood/releases/v3.6.0-rc2

mike.hart: watching canary metrics (p95, error-rate, cpu). hooking up the smoke test suite now.

jess: quick heads-up — customer-facing release note includes the new batching flag. product-docs-bot please confirm docs stamp.

product-docs-bot: docs: staging -> prod published for v3.6.0-rc2 :white_check_mark:

deploybot: canary passed initial health checks (error-rate <0.1%, p95 within SLO). shifting 10->50% over 2m.

sre-oncall: noticed small p95 bump on one shard, investigating cache pressure — correlating with new kv-cache changes.

mike.hart: hold traffic at 50% for now, running targeted load to reproduce. if we see >15% p95 regression rollback plan ready.

deploybot: traffic hold engaged at 50% (per request). rollback command available: `/deploy rollback --to 3.5.12 --reason lat-regression` (automated rollback requires :deploy-approve: from release-eng)

release-eng: thanks — pinning fallback tag v3.5.12 across routing policy and alerting QA. also noting commit diff in the release thread.

jess: confirmed a mis-tuned cache TTL in the canary config; patch in hf/ttl-adjust -> applying as hotfix to canary only.

deploybot: hotfix applied to canary (commit a1b2c3), re-running smoke tests.

mike.hart: smoke tests back to green, p95 trending back to baseline after 4m. recommend resume traffic shift.

olivia.nguyen: 👍 proceed with caution, keep the 15% buffer and monitor for 10m before full flip.

deploybot: resuming automated shift: 50->100% over 4m. will emit final complete when done.

sre-oncall: keeping extra retention on traces and enabling debug logs for the window.

deploybot: COMPLETE env=production tag=v3.6.0-rc2 commit=9f8e7d -> 100% traffic. duration=22m final_status=green

release-eng: releasing final changelog and tagging release as GA. follow-up: schedule postmortem notes only if anomalies surface.

olivia.nguyen: thanks team — observers stay on for 30m, otherwise we call this shipit. :shipit:

product-docs-bot: changelog published and release notes sent to customers list. :email:

mike.hart: closing monitor loop — no rollback needed. saved rollback command for 30m if needed.

deploybot: thread closed by deploybot. logs archived to internal S3: s3://redwood-deploy-logs/1769876501
